name: NIS2, Article 21(2)
notes: A cryptographic key in the files adds the cryptography letter (h).
As of October 2026 Spain has not transposed NIS2: the draft law of 14 January 2025 is still in passage, so for Spanish entities it is the obligation to come, and RDL 12/2018 the one in force.
